package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type studentLessonResponse struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	CourseID    string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt,omitempty"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Order       int    `json:"order"`
	Status      int    `json:"status"`
}

type studentTaskStarterFileResponse struct {
	Type          int16  `json:"type"`
	FileStorageID string `json:"filestorage_id"`
	Order         int    `json:"order"`
}

// studentTaskTestVariantResponse is an explicit public allow-list. Trusted
// correctness and grouping assignments must remain in TaskMetadata only.
type studentTaskTestVariantResponse struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Text  string `json:"text"`
	Order int    `json:"order"`
}

type studentTaskTestGroupResponse struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Order int    `json:"order"`
}

type studentTaskTestResponse struct {
	ID          string                           `json:"id"`
	Kind        string                           `json:"kind,omitempty"`
	Title       string                           `json:"title"`
	Description string                           `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Order       int                              `json:"order"`
	Groups      []studentTaskTestGroupResponse   `json:"groups,omitempty"`
	Variants    []studentTaskTestVariantResponse `json:"variants,omitempty"`
}

type studentTaskResponse struct {
	ID                     string                           `json:"id"`
	LessonID               string                           `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID               string                           `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Title                  string                           `json:"title"`
	Description            string                           `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Status                 int                              `json:"status"`
	Type                   int16                            `json:"type"`
	TaskKind               string                           `json:"task_kind,omitempty"`
	CodeStructureType      string                           `json:"code_structure_type_code,omitempty"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage                  `json:"code_structure,omitempty"`
	ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage                  `json:"compose_config,omitempty"`
	AllowedErrorsCount     int                              `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
	StarterFiles           []studentTaskStarterFileResponse `json:"starter_files,omitempty"`
	Tests                  []studentTaskTestResponse        `json:"tests,omitempty"`
	ExecutionMode          string                           `json:"execution_mode,omitempty"`
	EvaluationMode         string                           `json:"evaluation_mode,omitempty"`
	UIMode                 string                           `json:"ui_mode,omitempty"`
	SubmissionMode         string                           `json:"submission_mode,omitempty"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool                             `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool                             `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool                             `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool                             `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	MaxAttempts            *int                             `json:"max_attempts,omitempty"`
	DeadlineAt             *time.Time                       `json:"deadline_at,omitempty"`
}

type lessonLockedResponse struct {
	Code             string `json:"code"`
	Message          string `json:"message"`
	RedirectLessonID string `json:"redirect_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RedirectTaskID   string `json:"redirect_task_id,omitempty"`
}

func buildStudentLessonResponse(item *answeruc.LessonMetadata) studentLessonResponse {
	return studentLessonResponse{
		ID:          item.ID,
		CourseID:    item.CourseID,
		Title:       item.Title,
		Excerpt:     item.Excerpt,
		Description: item.Description,
		Order:       item.Order,
		Status:      item.Status,
	}
}

func buildStudentTaskResponse(item *answeruc.TaskMetadata) studentTaskResponse {
	tests := make([]studentTaskTestResponse, 0, len(item.Tests))
	for _, test := range item.Tests {
		groups := make([]studentTaskTestGroupResponse, 0, len(test.Groups))
		for _, group := range test.Groups {
			groups = append(groups, studentTaskTestGroupResponse{
				ID:    group.ID,
				Title: group.Title,
				Order: group.Order,
			})
		}
		variants := make([]studentTaskTestVariantResponse, 0, len(test.Variants))
		for _, variant := range test.Variants {
			variants = append(variants, studentTaskTestVariantResponse{
				ID:    variant.ID,
				Text:  variant.Text,
				Order: variant.Order,
			})
		}
		tests = append(tests, studentTaskTestResponse{
			ID:          test.ID,
			Kind:        test.Kind,
			Title:       test.Title,
			Description: test.Description,
			Order:       test.Order,
			Groups:      groups,
			Variants:    variants,
		})
	}

	starterFiles := make([]studentTaskStarterFileResponse, 0, len(item.StarterFiles))
	for _, starterFile := range item.StarterFiles {
		starterFiles = append(starterFiles, studentTaskStarterFileResponse{
			Type:          starterFile.Type,
			FileStorageID: starterFile.FileStorageID,
			Order:         starterFile.Order,
		})
	}

	return studentTaskResponse{
		ID:                     item.ID,
		LessonID:               item.LessonID,
		CourseID:               item.CourseID,
		Title:                  item.Title,
		Description:            item.Description,
		Status:                 item.Status,
		Type:                   item.Type,
		TaskKind:               item.TaskKind,
		CodeStructureType:      item.CodeStructureType,
		CodeStructure:          redactStudentCodeStructure(item.CodeStructure),
		ComposeConfig:          item.ComposeConfig,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     item.AllowedErrorsCount,
		StarterFiles:           starterFiles,
		Tests:                  tests,
		ExecutionMode:          item.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         item.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 item.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         item.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        item.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         item.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        item.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: item.SupportsLiveValidation,
		MaxAttempts:            item.MaxAttempts,
		DeadlineAt:             item.DeadlineAt,
	}
}

func redactStudentCodeStructure(input json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage {
	if len(input) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var value any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &value); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	redactStudentAnswerKeys(value)
	result, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return result
}

func redactStudentAnswerKeys(value any) {
	switch item := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		delete(item, "expected_answers")
		for _, nested := range item {
			redactStudentAnswerKeys(nested)
		}
	case []any:
		for _, nested := range item {
			redactStudentAnswerKeys(nested)
		}
	}
}

func writeLessonLocked(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, access *answeruc.LessonAccess) {
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusForbidden, lessonLockedResponse{
		Code:             "LESSON_LOCKED",
		Message:          "lesson is locked until previous lesson or task is completed",
		RedirectLessonID: access.RedirectLessonID,
		RedirectTaskID:   access.RedirectTaskID,
	})
}

func writeTaskLocked(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, access *answeruc.TaskAccess) {
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusForbidden, taskLockedResponse{
		Code:             "TASK_LOCKED",
		Message:          "task is locked until previous lesson or task is completed",
		RedirectLessonID: access.RedirectLessonID,
		RedirectTaskID:   access.RedirectTaskID,
	})
}
